messages.title: Mallakhamb Competition 2026
messages.description:
The ‘Mumbai Cha Raja Cup 2026’ Invitational Divisional Mallakhamb Competition, organized by Lalbaug Sarvajanik Utsav Mandal, Ganesh Galli (Mumbai Cha Raja), was successfully held on 26 April 2026 at Ganesh Galli .

The competition was conducted under the guidance of Ruturaj Sports Academy and with approval from the Maharashtra Amateur Mallakhamb Association and Mumbai City District Mallakhamb Association. It was inaugurated by Padma Shri Uday Deshpande Sir.

👉🏼 4 divisions | 17 teams | 140 players | 12 judges

Ruturaj Sports Academy emerged as the overall winner in both boys and girls categories, winning the ‘Mumbai Cha Raja Cup 2026’.

Congratulations to all participants!

messages.title: Playground
messages.description: Playground - the rightful place to nurture love for sports and discipline. On behalf of the above festival committee and under the guidance of Ruturaj Sports Academy, a training camp has been organized to maintain children’s physical and mental health balance through Mallakhamb / Rope Mallakhamb / Yoga / Gymnastics along with outdoor sports.

messages.title: Public Service is Divine Service
messages.description: On Saturday, 28th February 2026, on behalf of the above festival committee, the sarees offered to Lalbaug Mata were distributed as prasad to the devoted women of the Chaitraban area in Shahapur.

messages.title: Blockbuster Bappa – Mumbaicha Raja
messages.description: On behalf of Times of India–Bombay Times, our Mumbaicha Raja was honored with the prestigious title 'Blockbuster Bappa'. The award was presented to the Mandal by renowned singer Mr. Shaan.

messages.title: World Record Holder: Mumbai Cha Raja
messages.description:
The mandal has established two world records:
 1. Tallest Idol Legacy: The first mandal to maintain the tradition of installing the tallest Ganesh idol continuously for 48 years since 1977.
 2. Largest 24-Carat Gold Garland in the Public Institution Category: The 5.5 kg, 12-foot-long gold garland offered to Mumbai Cha Raja is recognized as the largest and heaviest in the world.
 Heartfelt congratulations to the mandal's office bearers, volunteers, members, donors, well-wishers, and all devotees of Mumbai Cha Raja.

messages.title: Winner (Best Decoration)
messages.description: Declared winner for Best Decoration in the 'Bappa Majha MahaGanesh Mandal Competition 2025' organized by abp Majha.

messages.title: Student Excellence Felicitation Ceremony - 2025
messages.description: On behalf of the above-mentioned festival committee, under the educational initiative, a felicitation ceremony was held with great enthusiasm on Saturday, 2nd August 2025 at Dr. Shirodkar High School Auditorium. The event aimed to encourage member students from the region who demonstrated exceptional academic performance in the year 2024–2025 across primary, secondary, and higher secondary examinations. Special appreciation and best wishes to all the meritorious students for their future journey!

messages.title: Outstanding Contribution to Social Work!
messages.description:
On Wednesday, April 16, 2025, Wockhardt Hospital honored the Mumbai Cha Raja Ganesh Galli Festival Committee for its remarkable contribution to community welfare.

Heartfelt congratulations to all members, volunteers, donors, and well-wishers 💐 and special thanks to the organizers 🙏🏼

messages.title: Safest Ganesh Festival Mandal – 2024 First Prize
messages.description: The “Mumbai Cha Raja, Ganesh Galli” committee was recognized as the safest Ganesh Festival Mandal for devotees. Awarded First Prize by FSAI for exemplary safety practices.

messages.title: 🎙️ Listen Up Mandali: Legacy of Traditions – Season 2
messages.description: Season 2 of the ‘Legacy of Traditions’ podcast celebrates cultural heritage, values, and stories. Proudly presented by the Mumbai Cha Raja Ganesh Galli committee.
